main_text.p: חבר Pahel Ch. Sociare, associare, consociare, componere, conjungere. Item Incantare, Deut.18. 11. in T. Jon. quasi, Consortium & commercium habere cum dæmonibus, vel Incantationibus multa animalia in unum locum consociare & congregare, ne lædant. Aphel אחבִיר Idem. Ithpahel אתחבר Associari, consociari, conjungi.
חבִירָא חבֵרָא Ch. & Syr. Socius, sodalis, amicus, collega. Plural. חבֵרִין חַבְרִין. Fœm. חברתָא Socia. Plur. חבַרָן.
חבורה Ch. Idem, Exod. 12. 45. Item Incantatio, וחבורי חבורא בישין Et incantans incantationes malas, Deut. 18.11. in T. Hierosol.
חבֵּרא Syr. Fossa, fovea, Matth.12.11. A חפר Fodere deductum, per commutationem ܚ & ܦ.
חבורין Chald. Vulnera, incisiones, cæsuræ, Deut.14.1. Targ. Hierof.
חבַרְבַר Obscurum, Lividum esse, מחברבר עלי Livida fit super me, Alii Obscurat me, Psal.139.11.
חברְבַר Ch. Cæcitas. Plur. חברבְּרִין Cæcitates. Gen.19.11. in Targ. Hierof. In Jonath. scribitur per ו.
חבש Syr. Claudere, concludere, includere. Ab Hebr. חבש Ligavit, alligavit.
ܚܒܫܐ Syr. Clau strum, carcer: Item Angustia, anxietas. Plur. ܚܒܫܝܢ In anxietatibus, 2. ad Cor.12.10. Græc. ἐν στενοχωρίαις. ܒܚܒܫܝܢ In carceres, Act.11.36.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are transcribed approximately; the Syriac and Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the scan are worn and uncertain. Marked forms are best readings.
